title: data/reports/index.json
description: A compact, columnar summary of every report, so the explore page can list, filter and search all of them without loading the report shards. Position n in every column is the same report. Reports are ordered newest first with undated ones last, then by title and id. The writer rebuilds this file from the shards and refuses any difference.

built_at.description: The built_at of build.json in the same build. The page compares the two to notice files from different builds.

id_len.description: How many characters of a SHA-1 report ID the id column keeps.

total.description: The number of reports. Every column has this many entries, and it equals the total length of the report shards.

tables.description: Each string that repeats is stored once here.

kev.description: Positions in tables.cves of the CVEs that are in the KEV catalogue.

columns.description: One array per field, each with total entries.

published.description: The publication date, or null when the report is undated. Undated reports come last.

organisation.description: A position in tables.organisations, or null when no source names the publisher.

sources.description: A bitmask over tables.sources: bit n is set when the source at position n lists the report. Never zero, because every report has a source.

actors_from_title.description: Positions in tables.actors of the actors that only the report's title names. Each is also in actors.

actorId.description: An ATT&CK group ID such as G0007, or a lower-case ASCII slug for an actor ATT&CK does not track. The ID is also the actor's file name and URL segment, so it has no colons, slashes or spaces, and it is never 'index'.

cve.description: A CVE ID in upper case.

label.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace and no line breaks.

nullableDate.description: A date, or null when none is known.

techniqueId.description: An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID.

sourceKey.description: A connector key such as attack or misp, as listed in sources.json. Never a display name.

reportId.description: The report's SHA-1 in lower-case hex when one is known, otherwise <source>:<source_id>.

indexId.description: A report ID as the index stores it. A SHA-1 digest is cut to the first id_len hex characters, at least 8, which the writer has checked is unique among the digests. Any other ID is kept whole.

position.description: A position in one of the tables. Zero is the first entry.

positions.description: Positions in one table, ascending, each at most once.
